backend.metadata: TiDB v8.5.6 unistore (upstream local development mode, not distributed TiKV)
backend.large_files: real MinIO S3 API on loopback, independent owned container and data directory

cache_policy: Writable same-handle read after file fsync, versus reopen after three seconds and two complete warm passes. Explicit per-sample cache protocol; no global eviction. Neither is a cold-storage test.
durability: explicit --durability=fsync: fsync waits for remote commit; ordinary write/close may complete before remote upload; upstream write workloads include fsync inside the timer
profile: none: all file paths, including .git, go through Drive9 remote persistent storage

comparison.vane_mutation_durability: Latest VaneFS: WAL/NORMAL with real FULL fsync barriers, per-request immediate transactions

host_telemetry: host-load.jsonl (one-second CPU, disk, PSI and memory snapshots)
cache_free_space_floor_override: 1% cache guard unchanged from prior local comparisons; retain at least 2 GiB additional free headroom

vane_build.prototype: selective publication and OPEN-only checkpoint coalescing

vane_cache_policy: current: live direct_io, disabled writeback, kernel TTL 60 seconds; 16MiB background threshold, 64MiB admission, 16MiB retained WAL; vacant-block batching
scope: Six balanced permutations of production SQLite BLOB, experimental selective external staging, and pinned local reference. Each fresh workload directory runs 64/256 MiB writes, explicit read-cache protocols, 512 random overwrites plus fsync, 128 small-file fsyncs and 128 namespace operations plus directory fsync. All scalar samples retained; no owned builds/tests overlap. Backend/cache/durability boundaries differ. Directory fsync on the reference remote namespace returns OK without an additional barrier.

host_summary.scope: Whole window, including monitor baseline, untimed work and unrelated host activity; not candidate-attributed.

read_path_diagnosis.note: Writable handles issue FUSE READ requests; settled readonly Drive9 measured reads hit kernel cache. Instrumented run is separate from throughput.

superseded_protocol: The first debug run showed immediate readonly reopen already using KEEP_CACHE; its results/logs are retained in cache-diagnosis. Final comparison uses O_RDWR for the writable case and O_RDONLY after settling/two warm passes for the cached case.
